The '''Thundering Herd''' was an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] unit of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] participated at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==History==
Composed of the first [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], the elite unit from the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] trained under [[Major General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] in planetary assaults. Hand-picked by Veers, the unit went on to become the core of [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] which was victorious at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
